description: The minimum defining a is attained and is no larger than any infinite maximal almost disjoint family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.almostDisjointnessNumber_spec :
  (∃ A,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsInfiniteMAD A ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑A = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.almostDisjointnessNumber) ∧
    ∀ (A : Set (Set ℕ)),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsInfiniteMAD A →
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.almostDisjointnessNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑A
